title: Yogurt, Granola, and Strawberries
description: The everyday breakfast: vanilla Greek yogurt, oat and honey granola, and a few fresh strawberries cut over the top. Five minutes, one bowl, no cooking, and nothing about it works better made ahead — the granola is the whole point and it softens within the hour.
ingredients: 1 c. (8 oz.) vanilla Greek yogurt (Oikos Triple Zero)
1/3 c. oat and honey granola (H-E-B Organics)

title: Cava-Style Chicken
description: Chicken thighs in a harissa marinade — lemon, honey, garlic, paprika, and cumin — baked in the oven and finished under the broiler. The honey and the harissa do most of the work: it browns hard at the edges and stays juicy in the middle. Built for lunches, over rice or salad or in a pita.
ingredients: 1 lb. boneless, skinless chicken thighs (4 to 6 pieces)

title: Harissa Baked Feta Pasta
description: An adaptation of Delish's baked feta pasta, reworked for meal prep, with harissa in place of the red pepper flakes and chickpeas and sausage to make it a full dinner. The core idea driving every change: make the sauce ahead, cook pasta fresh each night. Pasta does not survive storage in sauce; everything else does.
ingredients: 1 (15-oz.) can chickpeas, drained, rinsed, patted dry
12 oz. short tubular pasta, macaroni or cavatappi (3 oz. per serving)
12 oz. pork sausage, casings removed (3 oz. per serving)
1 Tbsp. fresh lemon juice (about 1 tsp. per serving)

title: Mediterranean Lunch Bowl
description: The thing all the Sunday prep is for. Greens, warm brown rice, harissa chicken, cucumber tomato salad, and three sauces, assembled in about five minutes and mixed together in the bowl. One weekend of cooking builds five of these.
ingredients: About 1 oz. lettuce blend, 1/5 of a 5 oz. box (H-E-B Organics romaine, butter lettuce, and arugula)
1/2 pouch ready brown rice (Ben's Original Whole Grain, 8.8 oz. pouch)
1/5 of a batch of Cava-style chicken
1/5 of a batch of cucumber tomato salad
2 Tbsp. roasted red pepper hummus (H-E-B Deli)

title: Cucumber Tomato Salad
description: Mediterranean chopped salad — cucumber, tomato, red onion, and a lot of parsley, dressed with nothing but olive oil, lemon, salt, and pepper. Fifteen minutes of knife work and no cooking. Good with pita and hummus, alongside marinated meats, or as the vegetable half of a prep container.
ingredients: 1/4 tsp. salt, plus more to taste
1/4 tsp. black pepper, plus more to taste

title: Ginger Mint Limeade
description: Tart and properly gingery, with the mint steeped into the hot syrup rather than muddled into the glass. The syrup keeps for two weeks, so the drink itself is a one-minute job once it's made.
ingredients: 3 oz. fresh ginger (a 4-inch piece), unpeeled, sliced into thin coins
1 packed c. fresh mint leaves and tender stems
1 c. fresh lime juice (from about 8 limes)
4 c. cold water or sparkling water
Lime wheels and mint sprigs, to serve

title: Harissa Paste
description: Tunisian-style, built to mimic Zwita Spicy: rehydrated dried chiles ground with raw garlic, freshly toasted coriander and caraway, salt, and a splash of vinegar, then loosened with olive oil and no further. Thick enough to hold a ridge on the spoon, garlicky, with heat that arrives slowly and stays. Makes about 1 1/2 cups, and it is the backbone of the chicken and the baked feta pasta.
ingredients: 1 1/2 tsp. fine sea salt, plus more to taste
1/4 c. extra-virgin olive oil, plus more for the jar

title: Lemon Herb Tahini
description: A CAVA copycat: six ingredients into a blender, nutty and lemon-sharp with a lot of cilantro. Five minutes, no cooking, and it goes on roasted vegetables, grain bowls, falafel, pitas, grilled meat, or anything that needs a creamy dressing. Makes about 1 cup (eight 2-Tbsp. servings).
ingredients: 1/4 c. fresh lemon juice (about 2 medium lemons)
3/4 c. cilantro, roughly chopped, stems included

title: Quick Pickled Red Onions
description: Sharp, sweet-sour, and bright pink within an hour. They keep for weeks and go on tacos, sandwiches, grain bowls, and anything rich enough to need cutting through.
ingredients: 1 large red onion (about 8 oz.), halved and sliced thin
